<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C12H16O2), DBE (5), presence of an aromatic ring (6 carbons), one carbonyl group, and one methyl group, the structure that fits all constraints is pentyl benzoate: a benzoate ester with a pentyl (five‑carbon) alkyl chain. Its SMILES representation is “O=C(OCCCC)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(OCCCC)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
